name: Visibility-Based Anti-Aliased Voxel Rendering
definition: A technique to reduce 'bloated' appearance and popping artifacts in voxel representations of small/thin objects by using semi-transparent voxels determined by ray-tracing visibility during preprocessing.
summary: Visibility-Based Anti-Aliased Voxel Rendering assigns directional opacity to voxels via ray-tracing to reduce bloated artifacts, differing from naive subdivision by filtering high frequencies through opacity blending.
